checks.name: the setters clamp to the panel ranges (and reject an unknown budget)
an unknown budget is ignored (the settings keep the old one)
an unknown render type falls back to off
M-cycle order is height → spread → gradient → off → height
the sky list takes every visible resident record (all five blocks)
the landmark block range is captured for the per-entry dispatch
invisible (thinned) records never enter the list
the capacity-vs-live-count difference does not rebuild the sky every frame
the nearest pick covers field stars (a catalog-only pick cannot win)
the nearest-N pick equals a brute-force scan of the whole resident sky (nearest-first)
a far catalog star never enters a nearest set
the set keeps birth records: one dispatch lands on the drawn positions (never twice)
a star-time sweep dispatches the whole sky and stamps its time
the re-pick at star time equals a brute-force scan of the DRAWN sky (the flat-map fix)
returning to star time 0 re-picks the birth sky
a selection resolves to its resident members only (a dead key drops)
a landmark member keeps its table index; a star member gets −1
a named selected landmark is labelled in the pick set
a stale slot hint falls back to an identity scan (key still wins)
constellations build the landmark table with its figures
every constellation anchor rides engineLandmarkPosition at the live star time
the layer copies the camera axes into the layout basis
the view layout matches the window aspect and the camera's FoV
the frame paints through the 2D canvas (map + legend)
the status line quotes the live anchors and range
half opacity blits the offscreen map with globalAlpha
the render type off hides the map canvas
the map stands aside for the system schematic
the map returns when the schematic closes
the plane layout is a chart driven by the look direction (lon 0 = look)
a 360° chart letterboxes to 2:1 instead of squashing the poles
the look direction lands at the chart centre
unchecking auto range freezes the live window into the manual sliders
a manual slider leaves auto off and keeps lo < hi
